activity.notes: The Dictionary of New Zealand Biography identifies Te Rauparaha as a Ngāti Toa leader, floruit 1810–1840. He was not born to the highest rank but rose to leadership through military and political ability. ATLAS therefore records Ngāti Toa, not a generic 'Māori' polity, and treats 1810–1840 as an approximate leadership floruit rather than inventing a formal accession or deposition date.

sources.title: Te Rauparaha
sources.citation_text: The Dictionary of New Zealand Biography at Te Ara identifies Te Rauparaha as a Ngāti Toa leader, gives a floruit of 1810–1840, and explains that he rose to leadership despite not being of the highest chiefly rank.
